decision: Selected the City of Frankfurt's official building-address point for Kleyerstraße 90 (address object DEHEFALK30007XiH), the address Equinix publishes for FR5, transformed from EPSG:25832 to WGS84, as the project locator. The coordinate in the map widget on Equinix's page was not used.

selected_properties.operator_published_address: Kleyerstrasse 90, 60326 Frankfurt (Equinix FR5 page, Internet Archive copy of 3 October 2026)

consistency_checks.prefix_query: A match_phrase_prefix query for 'Kleyerstraße 9' returns 14 building-address features; 'Kleyerstraße 90' is one feature (DEHEFALK30007XiH). The nearest other numbers in the response are Kleyerstraße 92 (DEHEFALK4uD0002i) and 92a-92d.
consistency_checks.crs: The geoportal configuration (https://geoportal.frankfurt.de/karte/config.json, captured 6 November 2026 by ops-frankfurt-de-p6, local local_data/country-research-ops-frankfurt-de-p6/frankfurt-geoportal-config.json, rehashed 7 November 2026, sha256 907501e96178af215a8fbe3d239ebd2d775fde13baf770ff0270d7e734053702) sets the routing geosearch on the same elastic service to epsg 25832, so the coordinates are ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N metres. The same service and transform underlie the published FR2, FR6, FR7 and Telehouse Frankfurt locators.

transform_check: pyproj 3.7.1 (PROJ 9.5.1) EPSG:25832 -> EPSG:4326, always_xy; rounded to 7 decimal places; the rounded point transforms back to within 0.005 m.

excluded_coordinates.kind: Map widget coordinate on the Equinix FR5 page
excluded_coordinates.reason: A map-embed parameter, which the locator policy excludes; not read or used.

limitations: The point is the register building-address point for the published address; it is not a parcel, building footprint or surveyed position, and the register states no positional accuracy.
